scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Have you
found Annon?
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
你找到安農了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
You haven't
found him yet?
Then where the
is he, then?!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
你還沒找到他？
那他在哪裡啊？！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Oh well...
I'm not sure if I can believe everything you said, but since you found the ring for me, that's good enough. Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
算了...
我不確定是否該完全相信你說的，但既然你幫我找到了戒指，那就夠了。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
If you happen to meet Annon during your travels, tell him to come back right away. You can go ahead and continue your adventures now~
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
如果你在旅途中遇到安農，告訴他馬上回來。你可以繼續你的冒險了~

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
If I ever
see him again...
He will be ^660000punished^000000...
^666666*grinds teeth*^000000

[Shuda]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
You haven't
found Annon yet?
I see. Oh well, it's alright.
Time isn't an issue for us.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
^666666*嘆氣...*^000000
你還沒找到安農？
我知道了。算了，沒關係。
時間對我們來說不是問題。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
And by 'us,' I mean '^660000you^000000.' I don't care about your plans or whatever else you may have scheduled, because you're going to make
time for me! Oho ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
這裡的“我們”指的是“^660000你^000000”。我不在乎你的計劃或其他安排，因為你要為我騰出時間！哦呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Ah... Is it...?!!
Yes, that's it!
My engagement ring that was
thrown into the water by that stupid Annon!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
啊...是...嗎？！
沒錯，就是這個！
被那個愚蠢的安農扔進水裡的訂婚戒指！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Thank you so much! In your honor, our first seven kids will be named after you! Oho ho ho ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
非常感謝！為了紀念你，我們的前七個孩子都會以你的名字命名！哦呵呵呵呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Now...
All I gotta do
is find Annon.
Where the hell
did that moron go?!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
現在...
我只需要找到安農。
那個蠢貨到底跑到哪裡去了？！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
^666666*Ahem*^000000
I-I didn't mean
to scare him, all I wanted was
my engagement ring back.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
^666666*咳咳*^000000
我...我不是故意嚇他的，我只是想把我的訂婚戒指拿回來。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
I guess the days
of being a happy bride
are still far away from me...
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
^666666*嘆氣*^000000
看來成為幸福新娘的日子還遙遙無期...

scripts.text:
^3355FFShuda gazes directly
at you with a puppy eyed look.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF舒達用小狗般的眼神直直地盯著你。^000000

scripts.text: D-Don't look at me that way!
scripts.translation: 別那樣看著我！

scripts.text: Alright, alright.
scripts.translation: 好吧，好吧。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Oh come on, you know everything that happened, and I know you're gonna continue adventuring
around this area.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
拜託了，你知道發生的一切，而且我知道你還會在這個地區繼續冒險。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I was just asking you to find Annon while you do that. Now, isn't that such a small favor? Thank you for doing this for me~
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
我只是想讓你順便找找安農。這難道不是個小忙嗎？謝謝你為我做這件事~

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
In the meantime, I'll think of how I'm gonna pay back Annon for leaving me in misery! So hurry and find Annon! Hoo ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
在此期間，我會想想怎麼報復安農讓我這麼痛苦！快去找到安農！呼呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(She's so scary!
Making me do stuff
for her again...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（她好可怕！
又讓我為她做事...）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Why am I always
doing things for other
people anyway?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我為什麼總是在為別人做事呢？！）

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Yes, I knew I could count on you! So find Annon! It's my destiny to make him ^660000mine^000000. Hoo ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
沒錯，我就知道可以指望你！快去找到安農！讓他成為^660000我的^000000，這是我的命運。呼呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I haven't seen him around the village for a while. And I don't think he jumped into the water to find my ring, since he's too sissy for that. He probably doesn't have the guts to see me without it.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
我在村子裡好久沒見到他了。我覺得他也不會跳進水裡去找我的戒指，因為他太膽小了。沒有戒指，他大概沒臉來見我。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Will you please tell Annon that
I got my ring back so he can come back to me now? I hope you'll remember that for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
請告訴安農，我已經找回戒指了，讓他現在回來找我好嗎？我希望你能記住這件事，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Huh...?
Did you find my ring?
Show me, show it to me!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
咦...？
你找到我的戒指了？
快給我看看，給我看看！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
What the...
You got nothing!
Don't lie to me,
bring me my ring!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
什麼...？
你什麼都沒找到！
別騙我，把我的戒指拿來！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Hurry up and find
my ring. I'll be waiting
here for the good news.
Oho ho ho ho ho~!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
快點找到我的戒指。我會在這裡等待好訊息。
哦呵呵呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I feel a little bad asking you this, especially since you're
an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
讓你做這件事，我有點過意不去，尤其是你還是個外人。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
But that ring is really important to me. If you could find it for me, I'd be the happiest woman in the whole world.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
但那枚戒指對我來說真的很重要。如果你能幫我找到它，我將會是世界上最幸福的女人。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
So please, I beg you.
Please bring my ring back to me.
I want to live with Annon as a happy couple forever. Can't you understand that?!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
所以拜託了，求求你了。
請把我的戒指還給我。
我想和安農永遠幸福地生活在一起。你難道不明白嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Umm...?
Ah, you must be one of the tourists. I'd guide you around and listen to your stories about the outside world, but...
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
嗯...？
啊，你一定是遊客吧。我本想帶你四處逛逛，聽聽你講講外面的世界，但是...

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
I'm reeeally
busy right now.
So very busy.
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
我現在真的
非常非常忙。
忙得不得了。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Huh...?
You don't think I look busy just because I'm standing on one spot and not moving at all?! Oh. My. God. You're so rude!
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
咦...？
難道你覺得我只是站在這裡不動，就不算忙嗎？！天哪。你太沒禮貌了！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Now, I've got to find my
engagement ring. If only
my fiancee hadn't
thrown it...
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
現在，我得去找我的
藍寶戒指。要是我的未婚夫
沒有把它扔出去就好了...

scripts.text: What...?
Lies~!
scripts.translation: 騙子~！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
What 'what?'
You still think I'm
standing around for my
own amusement or something?!
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
什麼叫“什麼”？
你還以為我站在這裡
是為了自己開心什麼的嗎？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No no no no...
I meant, I can't
believe that you're
engaged to someone!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不不不不...
我是說，我簡直不敢相信
你竟然訂婚了！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Wwwwaaaaaahhhhh!
Wh-who are you to say
something so rude to such a nice lady like myself. Go away, I don't wanna talk to you!
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
哇啊啊啊啊啊！
你算哪根蔥，敢對像我這樣
溫柔的女士說這種無禮的話。滾開，我不想理你！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
What lies?
I'm not gonna put up with crap
if you're gonna say something like 'I can't believe you're engaged to someone!'
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
什麼騙子？
如果你要說“我簡直不敢相信你訂婚了”這種話，
我可不會容忍這種廢話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa whoa whoa~
Calm down, lady.
Hear me out first.
What I'm wondering is...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀哎呀~
冷靜點，女士。
先聽我說完。
我想知道的是...

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
I know, I know.
You're wondering why I'm
standing near the water, right? Well, it's because my ring was thrown there and I've gotta
get it back.
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
我知道，我知道。
你肯定在想，我為什麼站在水邊，對吧？
因為我的戒指被扔進水裡了，我必須把它拿回來。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
What am I doing, talking to a tourist like this? ^666666*Sigh...*^000000 Well, you learned what you wanted to know. I hope you're satisfied now.
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
我這是在幹什麼，跟一個遊客聊這些？^666666*嘆氣*^000000
好吧，你已經知道了你想知道的事。希望你滿意了。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
...
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
...

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
...
......

[Powerful-Looking Woman]
...
......
........Hey.

[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Why are you staring at me?
Don't you have anything to do?
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
你一直盯著我看幹什麼？
難道你沒事做嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: No~ and you are an interesting girl.
scripts.translation: 沒有~ 而且你是個很有趣的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
I see. Hmmm...
You're kind of my type.
No no, that doesn't mean I'm interested in you. Plus I'm
already engaged.
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
是嗎。嗯...
你挺合我眼緣的。
不不，這不代表我對你有意思。況且我已經訂婚了。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
I see. Hmmm...
You're kind of my type.
Before you think of anything weird, I meant that I think you and me are a lot alike.
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
是嗎。嗯...
你挺合我眼緣的。
在你胡思亂想之前，我是說我覺得我們倆很像。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Let me introduce myself.
My name is Shuda, I've lived in Ayothaya all my life. Since you don't have anything to do, I have
a favor to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
讓我自我介紹一下。
我叫舒達，在哎喲泰雅長大。既然你沒事做，我有件事想拜託你。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
My fiance Annon is always interested in things other than me. I don't understand why, and I don't think I deserve to be ignored!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
我的未婚夫安農總是對除了我以外的事情感興趣。我不明白為什麼，我覺得我不應該被忽視！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Anyways, we're engaged
and we got rings for each other...
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
^666666*嘆氣*^000000
總之，我們訂婚了，
我們互相送了戒指...

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I thought being engaged would improve our relationship. But he just took my ring and threw it into the water.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
我以為訂婚會讓我們的關係變好。但他卻拿走了我的戒指，扔進了水裡。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I got upset and yelled at him to get my ring back for me, and then
I never saw him after that.
So what I want to ask is...
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
我很生氣，衝他大喊讓他把戒指給我拿回來，然後我就再也沒見過他。
所以我想問的是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You want me
to find your
ring, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是想讓我
幫你找回
戒指，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Ah...
So you know
what I want.
That makes it
much simpler.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
啊...
原來你知道
我想要什麼。
那就簡單多了。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
And once I retrieve
the ring, I'll make
him treat me to a much
deserved vacation in Jawaii...
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
等我拿回
戒指，我會讓他
帶我去爪哇
享受一場應得的假期...

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
...Where I will
^660000enslave^000000 him.
^666666*Grinds teeth*^000000

[{0}]
(...H-Horrifying!)

[Shuda]
So anyway, I want you to go out and find my engagement ring. Since the water is calm and still around here, the ring is probably still under the water, and hasn't been swept away yet.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
總之，我要你出去把我的藍寶戒指找回來。既然這裡的水很平靜，戒指應該還在水下，還沒被沖走。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
And so, that is my quest for you. It should keep you entertained for a while. So get into the water, and I'll supervise from here.
Oho ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
這就是交給你的任務。應該能讓你消遣一會兒。
快下水吧，我在這裡看著。
哦呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Are you gonna just stare and
not help at all? I thought the word adventurer was synonymous
with 'hero,' not 'lazy.'
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
^666666*嘆氣*^000000
你就打算這麼幹看著，一點忙都不幫嗎？
我以為“冒險者”這個詞等同於“英雄”，而不是“懶散”呢。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Oh I see...
Don't help strangers, do you?
Well, my name is Shuda, a beautiful damsel waiting for her engagement ring to rise up from the water.
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
哦，我明白了...
你不幫陌生人，是嗎？
好吧，我叫舒達，是一位美麗的淑女，正等待著我的藍寶戒指從水裡浮上來。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
There...!
We're not
strangers anymore!
Oho ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
好了！
我們
不再是
陌生人了！
哦呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Don't you pity me, and my tragic situation? If someone were to help this precious maiden find her ring, she'd be the happiest bride in the whole world.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
你不覺得可憐嗎，可憐我這種悲慘的處境？
如果有人能幫這位珍貴的淑女找回戒指，她將成為全世界最幸福的新娘。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
And her savior
would be known as
the hero of Ayothaya.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
而她的救星
將會被世人稱為
哎喲泰雅的英雄。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
 ...Say what?!

[Shuda]
Basically, you're gonna find my engagement ring, and I'll be the happiest bride in the whole world and I'll live happily ever after. What's so hard to understand
about that?
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
簡單來說，你要幫我找回藍寶戒指，然後我會成為全世界最幸福的新娘，從此過上幸福的生活。
這有什麼難懂的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Sure, Annon, he's my fiancee, is spineless and disappears whenever
I say something a little too harsh. What a little girl! Can't he see I'm trying to make him a better man?!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
沒錯，安農，我的未婚夫，是個沒骨頭的膽小鬼，只要我說得稍微嚴厲一點他就消失得無影無蹤。
真是個小女孩！他難道看不出我是想把他培養成一個更好的男人嗎？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He ran away
from you, didn't he?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他是不是
被你嚇跑了？

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Eh...?
What was that?
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
呃...？
你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^666666*Ahem*^000000
You're way
too good for him.
(I'd have run away myself!)

[Shuda]
Yes, yes, I know.
But what's important
is that once I get my ring back, Annon will be permanently mine. Till ^660000death do we part^000000.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
是的，是的，我知道。
但重要的是，一旦我拿回戒指，安農就永遠屬於我了。直到^660000死亡將我們分離^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
So, are you
gonna help me or what?!
If you do, me and Annon are gonna name our first seven children after you.
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
所以，你到底幫不幫我？！
如果你幫了，我和安農會把我們前七個孩子都取你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
So go and look under the water! There's no water current, so I'm sure it's still there! What are you waiting for, it's should be an easy swim for you! Oho ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒達]
快去水下找找看！這裡沒有水流，我確信它還在！
你在等什麼，對你來說這應該是個輕鬆的游泳任務！哦呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Why isn't it coming up from the water? Maybe if I stirred around with a wooden stick...?
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
^666666*嘆氣*^000000
為什麼它不從水裡浮上來呢？
也許我用木棍攪一攪...？

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
...?!
What are you
looking at?!
I'm busy, so if you
want something
I can't help you!
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
...？！
你在看什麼？！
我很忙，如果你有什麼事
我幫不了你！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
^666666Stupid tourists, running
around all over Ayothaya,
pestering and bothering
beautiful girls like me...^000000
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
^666666這些愚蠢的遊客，
在哎喲泰雅到處亂跑，
打擾和騷擾像我這樣
美麗的女孩...^000000

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Where the
hell is it!?
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
^666666*嘆氣*^000000
該死的，
它到底在哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
What are
you looking at?
Haven't you ever seen a delicate damsel sigh before? Leave me the hell alone!
scripts.translation:
[身形強壯的女子]
你在看什麼？
你以前沒見過
淑女嘆氣嗎？
給我滾開！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A blood stain?
What's going on?
I should take a look...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
血跡？
發生什麼事了？
我得去看看...

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnder a giant tree,
you find some bushes with
blood smudged on some
of the leaves.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在一棵巨大的樹下，
你發現了一些灌木叢，
有些葉子上沾著血跡。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWithin the bushes, you see
that the trail of blood continues, almost as if a bleeding animal struggled to find refuge within
the bushes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在灌木叢中，
你看到血跡的軌跡延伸著，
彷彿一隻受傷的野獸
曾掙扎著躲進灌木叢裡。^000000

scripts.text: Scatter the bushes.
scripts.translation: 撥開灌木叢

scripts.text: Dig up the bushes.
scripts.translation: 挖開灌木叢

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^666666*Cough cough*^000000
It's so dusty!

[?]
...Awwww
Oh... Oh God...!

[{0}]
Huh...?
I heard something
from below! Let's
dig it up!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦...？
我聽到下面有動靜！
讓我挖開看看！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pull up the bushes,
^3355FFand beneath the dust and
^3355FFshrubbery, you find
a small burrow.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拔起灌木叢，
^3355FF在灰塵和枝葉之下，
^3355FF你發現了一個
小小的洞穴。^000000

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
Wh...who's there?
Shuda?! If that's you,
stay back, or I'll kill myself!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
^666666*咳咳！*^000000
誰...誰在那兒？
舒達？！如果是你，
就站遠點，否則我就自殺了！

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: I'm not Shuda!
scripts.translation: 我不是舒達！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey...
What are you doi--
^3355FFHe vanished!^000000

[Haggard Man]
Hmmm...?
I sense kindess, sincerity and a general love for mankind in your voice. Verily, you are not Shuda.
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
嗯...？
我從你的聲音中感受到了
善意、真誠以及對人類的普遍關愛。
確實，你不是舒達。

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
You are unfamiliar to me, outsider. I'm unsure of how you found my hiding place, but if you have something to say, make it short!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
我不認識你，外來者。
我不知道你是怎麼找到我的藏身之處的，
但如果你有話要說，請長話短說！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou dig up the bushes, stirring
up a large, choking cloud of dust.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你挖開灌木叢，
揚起了一大團嗆人的灰塵。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
What a large,
choking cloud
of dust!

^3355FFAs you dig up the bushes, the ground beneath one of the bushes crumbles and you hear a scream
from beneath.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你挖開灌木叢時，
其中一叢下方的地面塌陷了，
你聽到下面傳來一聲尖叫。^000000

scripts.text:
[?]
^666666*Cough cough*^000000
...M-my legs!

[{0}]
Hmmm...?
What was that noise?
Ugh, it's awfully dusty.
I better stop digging.
^666666*cough cough cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
剛才那是什麼聲音？
唉，灰塵好大。
還是先停止挖掘吧。
^666666*咳咳咳*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find that the burrow is empty. It seems Annon has found a new hiding place.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現洞穴是空的。看來安農已經找到了新的藏身之處。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find a pile of dead bushes under a large tree. The area around the bushes seems awfully dusty.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在大樹下發現了一堆枯死的灌木。灌木周圍的地面似乎積滿了灰塵。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That looks
like blood!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那看起來
像是血跡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
Yes...
That's definitely blood.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
是的...
那絕對是血跡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Strange to see
a blood stain in
this kind of place...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在這種地方
看到血跡
真是奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
^666666*...Cough cough*^000000
No...! My hiding place!

[Haggard Man]
Hmmm...?
I'm bleeding?!
Oh, how did this happen?
My spiritual training wasn't supposed to go like this...!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
嗯...？
我在流血？！
噢，這是怎麼回事？
我的精神修煉不應該變成這樣...！

scripts.text: Treat his wound first.
scripts.translation: 先處理他的傷口

scripts.text: Is that you, Annon?
scripts.translation: 是你嗎，安農？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, I think you need to be treated. Let me check if I have some potions.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，我覺得你需要治療。讓我看看有沒有帶藥水。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah...
Here we are,
a White Potion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...
在這裡，
一瓶白色藥水。

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
You mean the White Potion,
the ultimate drink for healing?
I appreciate you doing me this favor. ^666666*Phew*^000000 Now, I feel much better.
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
你是說白色藥水，
那種終極的治癒飲品？
謝謝你幫我這個忙。^666666*呼*^000000 現在我感覺好多了。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Ah, my apologies for not introducing myself earlier.
I am called Annon. You must wondering what I must be doing
here under the ground.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
啊，抱歉剛才沒有自我介紹。
我叫安農。你一定很好奇我為什麼
會躲在地底下吧。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Well, I'm performing a special exercise for my spiritual training. Though, it may be hard to believe.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
嗯，我正在為我的精神修煉進行一項特殊的訓練。雖然這可能很難讓人相信。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
What...?
Shuda sent you?! Oh well...
I thank you for curing me. Now, it's time for me to resume my training.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
什麼...？
是舒達派你來的？！好吧...
謝謝你治好了我。現在，我該繼續我的訓練了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, I can't let you go! You don't know how hard it was for me to find you! You can't just leave!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，我不能讓你走！我費了好大勁才找到你！你不能就這樣離開！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Hm? Then what is it that you want? I implore you, do not tell Shuda that you have found me. No matter what, I am not going back to her!
scripts.translation:
[安農]
嗯？那你想要什麼？我懇求你，不要告訴舒達你找到我了。無論如何，我都不想回到她那裡！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Eh...?
Did you find
her ring already?
Ooh, I was hoping it
would never be found.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
呃...？
你已經找到
她的戒指了嗎？
噢，我本來希望
它永遠都不要被找到。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
She probably told you that I ran away out of shame for losing the ring, and that if you got the ring back, I'd be happy to return, right?
scripts.translation:
[安農]
她大概告訴你，我是因為弄丟戒指感到羞愧才逃跑的，如果你能找回戒指，我就願意回去，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Well...
I threw away
that ring on purpose!
I'm serious about not
going back to Shuda.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
嗯...
我是故意扔掉
那枚戒指的！
我是認真的，
我不想回到舒達身邊。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
It looks like you wish to know more. If you promise me that you will not mention my whereabouts
to Shuda, then I'll explain.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
看來你想知道更多。如果你答應我，
不把我的行蹤告訴舒達，
我就解釋給你聽。

scripts.text: You think the world revolves around you?
scripts.translation: 你以為世界是圍著你轉的嗎？

scripts.text: What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation: 你想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You think the world
revolves around you?
You can't just run away!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你以為世界是圍著你轉的嗎？
你不能就這樣逃跑！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Oh, I know, I know!
But you don't understand. Obviously, Shuda is beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
噢，我知道，我知道！
但你不明白。顯然，舒達很美麗。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
But our parents arranged our marriage when we were babies.
That kind of arrangement doesn't matter to me, but she obviously cares about it.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
但我們的父母在我們還是嬰兒時就為我們安排了婚事。
這種安排對我無所謂，但她顯然很在意。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
In all honesty, she scares me
to death. Whenever I'm with her,
I can't help but break into a cold sweat. And when she's near, I have nightmares about her. ^666666*Brrr...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[安農]
老實說，她讓我
嚇得要死。每次和她在一起，
我都忍不住冷汗直流。而且當她靠近時，我會做關於她的噩夢。 ^666666*瑟瑟發抖...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Annon]
She thinks it's funny to electrocute me. and ties me up in
a darkened room and feeds me only Jellopy whenever I don't listen to her. Now can you see why I crave freedom?
scripts.translation:
[安農]
她覺得電我很好玩。還會把我綁在
黑暗的房間裡，只要我不聽話，就只餵我吃傑勒比結晶。現在你能明白我為什麼渴望自由了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Of course, if you reveal to her that you've found me, I'll repay your favor. I implore you, just pretend you haven't found me, please?
scripts.translation:
[安農]
當然，如果你告訴她你找到我了，我會報答你的恩情。我懇求你，假裝沒找到我，好嗎？

scripts.text: ...Alright, alright.
scripts.translation: ...好吧，好吧。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Thank you so much!
Now, to pay you back, let me use one of the skills I've learned in my spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
非常感謝！
為了報答你，讓我使用一下我在靈性訓練中習得的技能。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Of course, what I want you to do is to keep me a secret from Shuda. Just forget that you've ever met me, and let Shuda know it was impossible to find me.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
當然，我想讓你做的是對我對舒達保密。就當你從未見過我，並告訴舒達根本不可能找到我。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Besides, even if you help her, all she'll do is offer to name her kids after you. Now... Do you really want that? I know for sure that she and I won't be having children. There's enough evil in the world.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
而且，即使你幫她，她只會提議用你的名字給她的孩子命名。現在...你真的想要那樣嗎？我確信我和她不會有孩子。世界上已經夠邪惡了。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Now, you must be wondering
how I would repay you for your silence. Well, let me show you one of the skills I've learned in my spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
現在，你一定在好奇
我會如何報答你的沉默。好吧，讓我展示一下我在靈性訓練中習得的技能。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Let's see...
Let me twist your
arm this way, and
apply pressure here...
scripts.translation:
[安農]
讓我看看...
讓我把你的手臂
這樣扭一下，
然後在這裡施加壓力...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wahhh~!
What the hell
are you doing!
You're hurting me, man!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇啊~！
你他媽在幹什麼！
你弄疼我了，混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Oh, this is a special kind
of massage. Don't worry, it'll
relieve you of fatigue. It's quite heavenly, actually. You'll see~
scripts.translation:
[安農]
噢，這是一種特殊的按摩。別擔心，它會
消除你的疲勞。其實相當美妙。你會看到的~

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Snap snap snap*
*Snap snap snap*
*Crack crack crack*
*Crack crack crack*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咔噠 咔噠 咔噠*
*咔噠 咔噠 咔噠*
*咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓*
*咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓*^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel as though Annon
realigned every bone in your skeleton, placing them in the right spots. Strangely, you feel intense relaxation and refreshment instead of excruciating pain.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你感覺安農
重新排列了你骨骼中的每一根骨頭，將它們放在正確的位置。奇怪的是，你感到的不是劇烈的疼痛，而是強烈的放鬆和清爽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...?
That felt was so great~
It even feels like my mind
has been cleansed too!
You've got a deal!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...？
感覺太棒了~
感覺連我的心靈
都被淨化了！
成交！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Thank you, thank you so much.
Now I can avoid being tied to Shuda, at least for a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[安農]
謝謝，太感謝了。
這樣我就能暫時擺脫舒達的糾纏，
至少能多撐一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Now, if you'll excuse me,
I must make good my escape
before others find me.
Good day~!
scripts.translation:
[安農]
那麼，失陪了，
我得趁別人發現我之前
趕緊溜走。
再見~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No way, no way.
He's too seriously
wounded to be cured
with the normal potions
that I have. I'll need
a stronger potion...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不行，不行。
他傷得太重了，
我手頭的普通藥水
治不了他。我需要
一種更強的藥水...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, you stay
here for a while.
I'll bring you some
medicine and treat
your wound.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，你先在這裡
待一會兒。
我去給你找些藥，
然後處理你的傷口。

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
No, you don't have to...
^666666*Cough cough cough*^000000
W-wait, don't push
me back inside!
Wahhhhhh~!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
不，不用了...
^666666*咳咳咳*^000000
等...等等，別把我
推回去！
哇啊啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, it's time
for me to play doctor!
I don't have much time!
My mission: Bring back an
ultra powerful potion for
this poor guy~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，是時候
讓我大顯身手了！
我沒多少時間了！
我的任務：為這位
可憐的傢伙帶回
一種超強力的藥水~

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
Annon...?
Who's that?
I've never heard of him!
I don't know him, okay!
Stop disturbing my training!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
安農...？
那是誰？
我從來沒聽說過他！
我不認識他，好嗎！
別打擾我訓練！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh...
Hmm, it doesn't seem like you should be yelling with that kind of wound. You sure you're not Annon?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...
嗯，你受了那樣的傷，
不應該這麼大聲喊叫。你確定你不是安農？

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
I told you!
I've never
heard of him!
L-leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
我說了！
我從來沒
聽說過他！
離...離我遠點！

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
I have to
hide from Shuda.
^666666*Cries*^000000
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
我必須
躲開舒達。
^666666*哭泣*^000000

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
Huh? Who are you?
This isn't a safe place for a tourists! You should leave right away!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
咦？你是誰？
這裡對遊客來說可不是安全的地方！你應該馬上離開！

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
This place is known to be
teeming with fish. The fish here tend to eat anything they find,
so it's easy to catch them.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
這裡以魚群眾多而聞名。這裡的魚通常什麼都吃，
所以很容易釣到它們。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
We are providing a fishing rod rental service. Every time you fish, you'll need ^3355FF 1 Monster's Feed^000000 to use as bait, and pay
a rod rental fee of ^3355FF50 Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
我們提供釣竿租賃服務。每次釣魚，你都需要^3355FF 1 魔物飼料^000000作為誘餌，並支付^3355FF50 Zeny^000000的釣竿租賃費。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
Would you
like to try?
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
你想
試試嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cast your
fishing line
into the water.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你將釣線
拋入水中。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou've hooked a Phen!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你釣到了一條劍魚！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhile cooking the Phen, you
find that it's swallowed a Stone.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在烹飪劍魚時，你
發現它吞下了一塊石頭。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside of the Phen,
you find a Red Potion.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在劍魚肚子裡，
你發現了一瓶紅色藥水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside of the Phen,
you find a Yellow Potion.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在劍魚肚子裡，
你發現了一瓶黃色藥水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's nothing inside...
But now you can eat Sushi!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF裡面什麼都沒有...
不過現在你可以吃明蝦壽司了！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find
a Flower Ring
inside the Phen.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在劍魚肚子裡
發現了一枚花戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find
a Diamond Ring
inside the Phen.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在劍魚肚子裡
發現了一枚鑽石戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a ring
with a name engraved
inside the band.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一枚戒指，
內圈刻著一個名字。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take the
engagement ring.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿起了那枚藍寶戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
Remember, you need ^3355FF1 Monster's Feed^000000 to use as bait and ^3355FF50 zeny^000000 to rend a rod.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
記住，你需要^3355FF1個魔物飼料^000000作為魚餌，以及^3355FF50 Zeny^000000來租用魚竿。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
No problem,
come back anytime you
want. Fishing relaxes
the mind and makes you
feel at peace...
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
沒問題，
隨時歡迎回來。
釣魚能讓人放鬆身心，
感到平靜...

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
The fish here tend
to eat anything they find.
When you gut them, you can
often find interesting things inside.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
這裡的魚
什麼都吃。
處理魚時，
你經常能在肚子裡發現有趣的東西。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
So when you get a chance,
why don't you sit down, relax
and enjoy some quiet fishing?
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
所以，當你有空的時候，
為什麼不坐下來，
放鬆一下，享受安靜的垂釣時光呢？

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
Welcome, long time no see!
It seems people learned that you found some kind of fortune from fishing here. After word got around, I've been getting lots
of customers.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
歡迎回來，好久不見！
看來人們已經知道在這裡釣魚能發現寶藏了。訊息傳開後，我的顧客多了不少。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
I understand that you want
fish, but right now there
aren't any fishing spots
for you at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
我知道你想釣魚，
但現在暫時沒有
適合你的釣點。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
Please let other
people have their
chance to find their
own fortunes.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
請讓其他人
也有機會
找到屬於他們的寶藏。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find footprints heading to the ^5C3317North^3355FF. It looks like somebody was in quite a hurry, just like the villager said!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一串通往^5C3317北方^3355FF的腳印。看起來有人很匆忙，就像村民說的那樣！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find another set of footprints. It seems that somebody was running away from something. These prints are heading to the ^5C3317East^3355FF. You'd better follow them to see what
you can find.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你又發現了一串腳印。似乎有人在逃離什麼。這些腳印通向^5C3317東方^3355FF。你最好跟著看看能發現什麼。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe footprints end around this area. Whoever was running must
have been exhausted and stumbled on something. Perhaps the owner of the footprints is nearby...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF腳印在這個區域附近消失了。逃跑的人一定累壞了，還絆到了什麼東西。也許腳印的主人就在附近...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you follow the footprints,
you arrive at the '^5C3317Entrance of the Shrine^3355FF.' Whoever this person was, he just ran into the second level.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF順著腳印，
你來到了'^5C3317神龕入口^3355FF'。不管這個人是誰，他剛跑進了第二層。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find the same footprints
in this place. It seems pretty
dangerous, and you wonder why
anyone would come here. The
footprints continue towards
the ^5C3317North^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在這裡發現了同樣的腳印。
這裡看起來很危險，
你想知道為什麼會有人來這裡。
腳印繼續通向^5C3317北方^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail of footprints
continue here, and seem
to look more freshly made.^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡的腳印
還在繼續，
而且看起來是剛留下的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHmm...?
There's something here...^000000
Ignore.
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: ^5C3317Investigate.^000000

[{0}]
Well, it's probably nothing. But which way should I go now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，可能沒什麼大事。但我現在該往哪邊走呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, this is a pack of White Potions. Whoever owned these must have dropped these by accident. Hmm, I could use these for later...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦，這是一包白色藥水。主人一定是不小心掉在這裡的。嗯，我可以留著以後用...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
There are more
footprints heading
toward the ^5C3317East^000000.
I better look
into this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
還有更多的腳印
通向^5C3317東方^000000。
我最好去調查一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, this is a pack of Yellow Potions. Whoever owned these must have dropped these by accident. Hmm, I could use these for later...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦，這是一包黃色藥水。主人一定是不小心掉在這裡的。嗯，我可以留著以後用...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
There are more
footprints heading
toward the ^5C3317East^000000.
I better look
into this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
還有更多的腳印
通向^5C3317東方^000000。
我最好去調查一下。

scripts.text:
[Rat]
^FF0000Squeak!
^FF0000Squeak Squeak!^000000

[{0}]
^8C1717Wah^000000!
What was that?!

^3355FFIt was just a rat.
It feels awful silly to be scared by just a little rat, does it not?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF只是一隻老鼠而已。
被一隻小老鼠嚇到，感覺挺傻的，不是嗎？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find another trail
of footprints that heads
towards the ^5C3317East^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現另一串腳印，
通向^5C3317東方^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhere is he...?
He seems to have gone
deep into the dungeon.
Just looking for this
guy is exhausting...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他在哪裡...？
他似乎深入了迷宮。
光是找這個人就讓人精疲力竭...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find traces of blood. Whoever was running in this direction may have been wounded. The trail of blood leads to the ^5C3317North^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了血跡。朝這個方向奔跑的人可能受了傷。血跡通向^5C3317北方^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Weird...
Why was that guy
running into the
shrine like that?
That really
bothers me...
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
奇怪...
那個人為什麼
會那樣跑進
神龕裡？
這真的
讓我很在意...

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Oh, aren't you
from Midgard?
Hello there~
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
哦，你是
來自米德加爾特的人嗎？
你好呀~

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Ah...
You heard me talking to myself? Well, I didn't see who he was but, some guy ran into the forest which leads to the shrine. He seemed really terrified of something.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
啊...
你聽到我自說自話了？好吧，我沒看清他是誰，但有個人跑進了通往神龕的普勒斯特森林。他看起來非常害怕什麼東西。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
He came from out of nowhere, so he scared the crap out of me. Do you think he could be a criminal?
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
他突然出現，把我嚇得半死。你覺得他可能是個罪犯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Ah! I think, in his intense fear, he was screaming something about some kind of '^FF0000Shuda^000000,' or whatever. But what could it possibly mean?
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
啊！我想，他在極度恐懼中，好像在大聲喊著什麼“^FF0000舒達^000000”之類的。但那到底是什麼意思呢？

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Oh well, don't worry. All of our villagers aren't like that. Anyway, I hope you enjoy your travels in Ayothaya.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
算了，別擔心。我們村裡的村民不都是那樣的。總之，祝你在哎喲泰雅旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Oh hello~
I can tell from your clothes that you must be from Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
哦，你好~
看你的穿著，你一定是來自米德加爾特的人。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Recently, it seems that
our village has been receiving
more tourism, and I can see that
our village is being influenced
in a positive way.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
最近，似乎
我們村莊接待了
更多的遊客，我能感覺到
我們的村莊正在
受到積極的影響。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Ah...
While you're here,
why don't you taste some
authentic Ayothaya cuisine
for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
啊...
既然你在這裡，
何不親自嚐嚐
正宗的哎喲泰雅美食呢？

scripts.text:
[Tham]
We're known for our
spicy and sweet seafood,
and there are some nice
restaurants around here.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
我們以
辛辣甜美的海鮮聞名，
這裡附近
有一些不錯的
餐廳。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Anyway, I'm sure that you'll like it. I hope that you come visit Ayothaya as often as you can~
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
總之，我相信你一定會喜歡的。希望你能儘可能常來哎喲泰雅做客~

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Ah~
I've got this craving for Ms. Mali the Spicy's food, especially her 'Tom Yum Goong.'
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
啊~
我突然很想念辣妹 瑪麗做的菜，尤其是她的“泰式BBQ”。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
I think it's the
most delicious dish
in the entire world!
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
我覺得那是
世界上最美味的一道菜！

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Oh hello~
I can tell from your clothes that you must be from Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
哦，你好~
看你的穿著，你一定是來自米德加爾特的人。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
I hope that you enjoy your stay here, and that you come visit Ayothaya as often as you can~
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
希望你在我們這裡住得愉快，
也希望能儘可能常來哎喲泰雅做客~

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Oh...!
You must be a traveller.
I have a tale you may wish to hear if you're interested in listening.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
哦...！
你一定是位旅行者吧。
如果你有興趣聽的話，我有一個故事想講給你聽。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什麼事？

scripts.text: I know what the story is.
scripts.translation: 我知道這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Ayothaya has a long history. Perhaps it looks calm and peaceful now, but in the past our village was terrorized by a terrible creature.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
哎喲泰雅有著悠久的歷史。雖然現在看起來平靜祥和，但在過去，我們的村莊曾被一種可怕的生物所 terrorized。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
This beast is known to us as
the ^660000Sa-mhing Tiger^000000, which used
to dwell deep in the ancient ruins.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
這種生物被稱為
^660000薩姆亨虎^000000，它曾棲息在古老的遺蹟深處。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
The Sa-mhing Tiger is addicted
to the taste of human flesh. It has been known to transform into the shape of a person it has eaten in order to lure out his family and friends.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
薩姆亨虎沉迷於人類肉體的味道。它曾化身為它所吃掉的人的模樣，以此引誘其家人和朋友。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
The local people are still afraid that the creature might transform into someone they know, and sneak into their homes to eat them.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
當地人仍然害怕這種生物會化身為他們認識的人，潛入家中將他們吃掉。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
However, there is one way you can identify the Sa-mhing Tiger from a human being. Since it's a tiger, it cannot do some of the things
humans are taught to do,
such as light a match.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
不過，有一種方法可以分辨薩姆亨虎和人類。因為它本質上是老虎，所以它無法做到一些人類學會的事情，比如劃火柴。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
So, if by any chance you see
a friend acting strangely all
of a sudden, ask him to strike
a match. Make sure he is not
the Sa-mhing Tiger.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
所以，如果你偶然看到朋友突然行為怪異，就讓他劃一根火柴。確認他不是薩姆亨虎。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
However...
I'm not sure if this actually works or not. I guess the best thing to do is just run for your life if you even suspect someone of being
the Sa-mhing Tiger.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
但是...
我不確定這招是否真的有效。我想最好的辦法是，一旦懷疑某人是薩姆亨虎，就拼命逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Do you believe
in the existance
of man-eating tigers?
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
你相信
食人虎的存在嗎？

scripts.text: Well, not really.
scripts.translation: 嗯，不太相信。

scripts.text: Yes, I do and I think they're scary!
scripts.translation: 相信，我覺得它們很可怕！

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Umm...
Oh well. My late grandfather told me about the Sa-mhing Tiger when
I was a little kid. Of course,
I haven't seen it.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
嗯...
算了。我小時候，已故的祖父曾給我講過薩姆亨虎的故事。當然，我並沒有親眼見過它。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
The closest thing I've seen to the Sa-mhing Tiger was a golden cat with a bell. Somehow, I don't think it ate men.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
我見過最接近薩姆亨虎的東西，是一隻戴著鈴鐺的金貓。不過，我不覺得它會吃人。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Run for your life if you ever encounter the Sa-mhing Tiger!
It'll eat you alive!
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
如果你遇到薩姆亨虎，請拼命逃跑！
它會把你活活吃掉的！

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
If you're interested in finding
out more about the story, I can introduce you to someone who
knows that creature more than
anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
如果你有興趣瞭解更多關於這個故事的內容，我可以介紹你認識一個人，他比任何人都更瞭解那種生物。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Why don't you talk to Boonthom? He's a pretty strange person, but there's something about him...
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
你為什麼不和本通談談呢？他是個挺奇怪的人，但他身上有種...說不清的感覺。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Ah well, you'll see what I'm talking about. I hope he'll help you learn more about that evil creature.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
算了，你親自去看看吧。希望他能幫你瞭解更多關於那個邪惡生物的事情。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
You do now?
Then be careful!
It'll eat you alive!
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
你現在知道了？
那一定要小心！
它會把你活活吃掉的！

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
How are you?
If you're interested
in the Sa-mhing Tiger,
please go talk to Boonthom.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
你好嗎？
如果你對薩姆亨虎感興趣，
請去和本通談談。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
But beware!
The Sa-mhing Tiger might be
closer to you than you expect!
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
但請小心！
薩姆亨虎可能比你想像的離你更近！

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
You...!
Isn't it....!
Oooooohhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[本通]
你...！
難道不是....！
噢噢噢噢噢！

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Oh...?

[Boonthom]
...

[Boonthom]
...
......

[Boonthom]
Never mind.
Hah! I've lost my
train of thought.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
算了。
哈哈！我剛才走神了。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
So have you come to me to seek help? I can see the fear in your eyes. Let me gaze into your soul, and see what your fear is for myself. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
所以你是來向我求助的嗎？我能看到你眼中的恐懼。讓我凝視你的靈魂，看看你究竟在害怕什麼。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
...

[Boonthom]
...
......

[Boonthom]
What...!
I see that you dread the Sa-mhing Tiger! I haven't heard any news of that monster for a long time...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
什麼...！
原來你害怕的是薩姆亨虎！我已經很久沒有聽到關於那個魔物的訊息了...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
A long time ago,
the Sa-mhing Tiger
really did roam the village
and ate innocent people.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
很久以前，
薩姆亨虎確實曾在村莊裡遊蕩，
併吞噬無辜的村民。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
However, its terror
was brought to an end when it
was finally captured. I was one of those involved in capturing the Sa-mhing Tiger.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
不過，它的恐怖統治終於結束了，因為它被捕獲了。我是參與捕獲薩姆亨虎的人之一。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
I insisted killing on it, but the other people were too afraid to do so. Instead, the Sa-mhing Tiger
was locked in a cave inside of the ancient ruins.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
我堅持要殺掉它，但其他人太害怕了，不敢動手。於是，薩姆亨虎被鎖在了古代遺蹟裡的一個洞穴中。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
I believe that was at least 10 years ago. Perhaps it's already dead by now. However, no one
knows how powerful the tiger truly
is. It may still be alive.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
我想那至少是10年前的事了。也許它現在已經死了。但是，沒人知道這隻老虎究竟有多強大。它可能還活著。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
I don't think we need to worry about it though. It is locked up and there it shall remain.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
不過我覺得我們不需要擔心。它被鎖起來了，而且會一直留在那裡。

scripts.text: I want to explore the ancient ruins.
scripts.translation: 我想探索古代遺蹟。

scripts.text: Locked up! Good! I'm not afraid!
scripts.translation: 鎖起來了！很好！我不怕！

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
You...
You are strange.
You want to explore the ancient ruins. Do all adventurers disregard their safety like that?
scripts.translation:
[本通]
你...
真奇怪。
你想探索古代遺蹟。難道所有冒險者都不顧自身安危嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
It's your choice. But remember, it is very dangerous to go through the path to the center of the building. Usually, I forbid it.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
這是你的選擇。但請記住，通往建築中心的路非常危險。通常，我是禁止通行的。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
But if you want to go in,
I can give you some useful tips.
Would you like to listen?
scripts.translation:
[本通]
但如果你執意要進去，
我可以給你一些有用的建議。
你想聽聽嗎？

scripts.text: If it's that dangerous, I'd rather not try.
scripts.translation: 既然那麼危險，我還是不去了。

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
You made a good decision.
You'd better be careful if
you want to stay alive.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
你做了一個明智的決定。
如果你想活著，最好小心點。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Umm, okay.
Since you're
that interested...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
嗯，好吧。
既然你那麼感興趣...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
If you wish to enter the ancient building, you must have protection against evil spirits and malice.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
如果你想進入這座古建築，你必須擁有對抗邪靈和惡意的手段。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Even if you can
wield the power of
holiness, you will still need the spiritual security of our land.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
即使你能
運用神聖的力量，
你仍然需要這片土地的精神庇護。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
There are many ghosts and
demons within the cave, and they will attack people who do not possess holy power... Like you.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
洞穴裡有許多幽靈和惡魔，它們會攻擊沒有神聖力量的人...比如你。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
I can make you an object
containing this holy power if you wish. In order to make it, I will need some materials.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
如果你願意，
我可以為你製作一件蘊含這種神聖力量的物品。為了製作它，我需要一些材料。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Please come back
when you prepare all
the materials.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
請準備好所有材料後
再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Hmmm...
Not afraid
of it, are you?
scripts.translation:
[本通]
嗯...
你並不害怕，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Excellent!
Now you have brought
everything I need. Let me make
the thing for you as promised...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
太好了！
現在你已經帶來了
我需要的東西。讓我按承諾為你製作吧...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Ooooohmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
噢噢噢姆姆姆...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Hmmmmmm...
Hmmmmmmmmm.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
嗯嗯嗯嗯...
嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Pffff pffff...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
噗噗 噗噗...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Here you go.
Please take these holy threads.
With this, you will be able to enter the ruins with less worry.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
給你。

scripts.translation: ^3355FF上面寫著“^0000FF你需要更多...神聖力量...為了...^3355FF”。你無法閱讀剩下的資訊。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find a piece of a stone slate with letters etched on it. It seems to be the 5th part of the slate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一塊刻有文字的石板碎片。
這似乎是石板的第5部分。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find a piece of a stone slate with letters etched on it. It seems to be the last part of the slate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一塊刻有文字的石板碎片。
這似乎是石板的最後一部分。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt reads '^0000FFOtherwise, it's impossible...^3355FF' You are unable to read the rest of the message.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF上面寫著“^0000FF否則，這是不可能的...^3355FF”。你無法閱讀剩下的資訊。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find a piece of a stone slate with letters etched on it. It seems to be the last part of the slate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一塊刻有文字的石板碎片。
這似乎是石板的最後一部分。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe holy threads
emanate a powerful sense
of safety and security.
With the protection of
holiness, you begin your
descent into the 2nd level.^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF神聖線紗散發出強大的安全感。
在神聖力量的庇護下，你開始向第二層地下進發。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find what seems to be the entrance to the 2nd level. However, you are filled with an overwhelming sense of dread. Somehow, you can't bring yourself to go down...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你找到了通往第二層地下的入口。然而，一股壓倒性的恐懼感湧上心頭。不知為何，你無法鼓起勇氣走下去...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find what seems to be the entrance to the 2nd level. However, you are filled with an overwhelming sense of dread. Somehow, you can't bring yourself to go down...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你找到了通往第二層地下的入口。然而，一股壓倒性的恐懼感湧上心頭。不知為何，你無法鼓起勇氣走下去...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find half of the skeletal remains of a person sticking out from the ground. It seems to be the remains of Boonthom's comrade.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現半具從地面伸出的骸骨。
這似乎是本通同志的遺骸。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find a piece of paper beside the skeleton, as well as a box.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在骸骨旁邊發現了一張紙和一個盒子。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou read what is written on the old sheet of paper. The letters have faded with age, and it is difficult to read.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你閱讀那張舊紙上的文字。
字跡因年代久遠而褪色，難以辨認。^000000

scripts.text:
[Old Letter]
^333333Dear, Boonthom,
I was a fool. There is 'Sa-mhing Tig'...One who ....my remains... Please take...to Boonthom...
scripts.translation:
[舊信]
^333333親愛的本通：
我是個傻瓜。那裡有“薩姆辛·蒂格”...一個...我的遺骸...請帶...給本通...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pick
up the box.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你撿起了那個盒子。^000000

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Do you know what the
most popular cuisine
of this village is?
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
你知道這個村莊最受歡迎的料理是什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Ayothaya is world famous
for its regional cuisine, but
out of all Ayothayan dishes,
'^3131FFTom Yum Goong^000000' is the best.
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
哎喲泰雅以地方美食聞名於世，但在所有哎喲泰雅菜餚中，'^3131FF泰式BBQ^000000'是最棒的。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Tom Yum Goong is a type
of soup that is very spicy. Try it once, and you will be amazed by its profound taste. Try it twice, and you will be enraptured by its tantalizing aroma.
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
泰式BBQ是一種非常辣的湯。嘗一次，你會被它深邃的味道所驚歎；嘗兩次，你會被它誘人的香氣所迷住。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
It's really one of the most delicious foods in the world!
Everyone in the world would
want to try this at least once in his lifetime. So, would you like
to try some?
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
它真的是世界上最美味的食物之一！
世界上每個人都想至少嘗一次。那麼，你想嚐嚐嗎？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。

scripts.text: No, thanks. I hate spicy food.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝。我不吃辣。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Okay...!
Now who would be
best for preparing
Tom Yum Goong for you?
Hmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
好的...！
那麼，誰最適合為您準備泰式BBQ呢？
嗯......

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Everyone in the village
knows how to make it, but
I recommend that you go
visit ^3131FFMali the Spicy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
村裡的人都會做，但我建議您去拜訪^3131FF辣妹 瑪麗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
She is the best cook when it
comes to Tom Yum Goong!
Why don't you ask her
to cook you some?
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
她是做泰式BBQ最厲害的廚師！
您何不請她為您做一份呢？

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Oh I see...
However, when you
change your mind,
please come back.
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
哦，我明白了...
不過，如果您改變主意了，
請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Ah, you wanna know
where ^3131FFMali the Spicy^000000 is?
Well, there's not too many places
a cook would stay other than in
a restaurant, right? Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
啊，您想知道^3131FF辣妹 瑪麗^000000在哪裡嗎？
嗯，除了餐廳，廚師還能待在哪裡呢，對吧？哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Golden Ayothaya...
Although I've grown
up in this village,
I still think my village
is magnificient and beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
金色的哎喲泰雅...
雖然我就出生在這個村莊，
但我依然覺得我的村莊
壯麗而美麗。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
What do you think?
Wouldn't you agree with me?
scripts.translation:
[艾農]
您覺得呢？
您不會同意我的看法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Hello, there!
I am called Mali the Spicy.
All of my dishes always amaze
my customers with their tempting scents and deep flavors.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
你好呀！
我叫辣妹 瑪麗。
我的每一道菜都能以其誘人的香氣和濃郁的味道
讓顧客們驚歎不已。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I am especially proud of my
^3131FFTom Yum Goong^000000, which is the
best in the village. I suppose
it's my fate to cook the greatest Tom Yum Goong ever.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
我尤其以我的^3131FF泰式BBQ^000000為榮，它是村裡最好的。我想，
烹飪出史上最棒的泰式BBQ就是我的命運吧。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Oh I see...
You want me to cook
Tom Yum Goong for you,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
哦，我明白了...
您是想讓我為您做一份泰式BBQ，
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Honestly, I've been really
busy ever since I opened this restaurant. If you really wish to taste my Tom Yum Goong, would
you do something for me?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
說實話，自從開了這家餐廳以來，我一直很忙。如果您真的想品嚐我的泰式BBQ，您願意為我做件事嗎？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: Eh... I dunno.
scripts.translation: 呃...我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
First, would you get
the ingredients to make
Tom Yum Goong for me? I'll need some ^CE0000Shrimps^000000, ^CE0000Chiles^000000 and ^CE0000Lemons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
首先，您能幫我弄到做泰式BBQ的食材嗎？我需要一些^CE0000蝦^000000、^CE0000辣椒^000000和^CE0000檸檬^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Remember, Shrimp is the main ingredient of this dish. So, the fresher the Shrimp, the tastier your food will be.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
記住，蝦是這道菜的主料。所以，蝦越新鮮，食物就越美味。

scripts.text: Where can I find them?
scripts.translation: 我在哪裡能找到它們？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I expected you
to ask me that.
For Shrimps, look around
the beach. You should see
a lot of them there.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
我就知道您會問這個。
至於蝦，去海灘周圍找找看。您應該能看到很多。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
However, you might have a hard time finding them since you haven't done that before. So just buy some Shrimp from the guy who sells
the freshest Shrimp around.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
不過，由於您以前沒做過，可能會很難找到。所以，您可以直接從賣最新鮮蝦的那個人那裡買一些。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Hmmm...
If you mention
my name, that guy
might give you a discount.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
嗯...
如果您提到我的名字，那個人
可能會給您打折。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
His name is ^3131FFThongpool^000000.
He will be somewhere around the village selling Shrimps. Go and ask him to give you 20 Shrimps to cook Tom Yum Goong.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
他叫^3131FF通普^000000。
他會在村莊附近賣蝦。去請他給您20只蝦來做泰式BBQ吧。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I understand this might be difficult to do, but it's worth
a try if you really want to taste the best Tom Yum Goong.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
我知道這可能有點難，但如果您真的想品嚐最好的泰式BBQ，值得一試。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Errr...
What's wrong with these Shrimp?
They all have these scratches and rips in them! I can't believe Thongpool sold such bad Shrimp
to his customers!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
哎呀...
這些蝦怎麼回事？
它們身上全是劃痕和破口！真不敢相信通普會把這麼差的蝦賣給顧客！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I'm so sorry, but
I can't cook the best
Tom Yum Goong with
these Shrimp.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
非常抱歉，
用這些蝦
我沒法做出
最好的泰式BBQ。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I know it's an inconvenience, but would you go back to Thongpool
and ask him to give you the freshest Shrimp to cook the best
Tom Yum Goong?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
我知道這給您添麻煩了，但您能回到通普那裡，
請他給您最新鮮的蝦，
以便我做出最好的泰式BBQ嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Ah, you came back!
Now, let me see what
you've brought. Hmm...
These are...
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
啊，您回來了！
讓我看看您帶了什麼。嗯...
這些是...

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
The freshest Shrimp that
I've been looking for! Well done~
With these big and fresh Shrimp,
I can cook the best Tom Yum Goong for you! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
正是我尋找的最新鮮的蝦！做得好~
有了這些又大又新鮮的蝦，
我就能為您做出最好的泰式BBQ了！太感謝您了！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
It will be a perfect food with the natural sweetness of the Shrimp, the sourness of Lemons and a little bit of fish sauce!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
這將是一道完美的料理，擁有蝦的天然甜味、檸檬的酸味，還有一點點魚露的鮮味！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Oh... Right.
But we only have Shrimp.
Now, I want you to bring
me some ^CE0000Lemons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
哦...對了。
但我們現在只有蝦。
現在，請您去給我帶一些^CE0000檸檬^000000。

scripts.text: Where can I find Lemons?
scripts.translation: 我在哪裡能找到檸檬？

scripts.text: I hate sour food. I'd better quit!
scripts.translation: 我討厭酸的食物。我還是放棄吧！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
A few days ago, I saw a good
Lemon tree while taking a walk.
But this tree belongs to an ordinary man who's not a Fruit Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
幾天前，我散步時看到了一棵很好的檸檬樹。
但這棵樹屬於一個普通男子，他並不是水果商人。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I'm not sure whether
or not he'd sell Lemons
to you, but you can try,
I guess.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
我不確定他
會不會把檸檬
賣給您，但您可以試試，
我想。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
What a stupid...!
If you quit just because you really hate sour flavors, you must not be that eager to have my Tom Yum Goong!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
真笨...！
如果您僅僅因為討厭酸味就放棄，那您一定不是真的想品嚐我的泰式BBQ！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Once you taste my
Tom Yum Goong, you'll
regret what you just said!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
一旦您嚐到我的
泰式BBQ，您就會
後悔剛才說的話！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Huh...?
What did you do
with the Shrimps?
You didn't eat them
on the way here, did you?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
嗯...？
您把蝦怎麼了？
您不會在半路上
把它們吃了吧？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Make sure you ask
Mr. Thongpool to give
you 20 Shrimps.
Now hurry~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
一定要請通普先生
給您20只蝦。
現在快去吧~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
You think these are
the best quality Lemons?
Take a closer look!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
您覺得這些是
質量最好的檸檬？
仔細看看！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
The skin of these
Lemons lack luster
and they don't even smell
fresh! They're just
common Lemons!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
這些檸檬的表皮
缺乏光澤，
甚至聞起來都不新鮮！它們只是
普通的檸檬！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Welcome back!
Wow, you came back
really fast! Okay, let me
see the Lemons
you brought?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
歡迎回來！
哇，您回來得真快！好的，讓我
看看您帶的檸檬？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Wow, great!
These are really fresh Lemons!
How could you bring all of these by yourself? Thanks for your trouble~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
哇，太棒了！
這些真是新鮮的檸檬！
您是怎麼一個人帶這麼多來的？謝謝您的辛苦~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Now, you should go buy
some ^CE0000Chiles^000000 and some
other materials in the Market.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
現在，您應該去市場買一些^CE0000辣椒^000000和其他材料。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
When you talk
to the Merchants
in the Market, they
will know what you want.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
當您與市場裡的商人交談時，
他們會知道您想要什麼。

scripts.text: Okay, I'll be right back.
scripts.translation: 好的，我馬上回來。

scripts.text: Ah, I'm tired now. Let me take a rest first...
scripts.translation: 啊，我現在累了。讓我先休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
See you in a bit~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
一會兒見~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
It's your call.
But remember...
The Shrimps might go bad
while you're taking a rest.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
隨您便。
但請記住...
您休息的時候，
蝦可能會變質的。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Huh...?
What did you
do with Lemons?
You didn't eat them
all on the way here, did you?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
嗯...？
你對檸檬做了什麼？
你難道在來的路上
把它們全吃光了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Alright...
I'm counting on you
to get the best Lemons
from the guy that owns that tree.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
好吧...
我指望你從那個
擁有那棵樹的人那裡
買到最好的檸檬。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Somehow, you've got
to get those high quality
Lemons so that I can make
some Tom Yum Goong!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
總之，
你必須弄到那些高品質的檸檬，
這樣我才能做泰式BBQ！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I don't understand...
Where did you get these
bad ingredients?! Didn't
I tell you that my
Tom Yum Goong
requires the best?!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
我不明白...
你從哪弄來這些
劣質食材的？！我不是說過
我的泰式BBQ
需要最好的嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I know you've been working hard to do me this favor. I hope you'll put forth that last little bit of effort to finish this.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
我知道你為了幫我這個忙很努力。我希望你能再堅持一下，完成這件事。

scripts.text:
[Malli the Spicy]
Please go take a look in the Market. I don't doubt that it will be a good experience. After all, my fantastic Tom Yum Goong is waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
請去市場看看吧。我相信這會是一次很好的體驗。畢竟，我美味的泰式BBQ在等著你！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Now...
Everything is all set!
Before we start, let me
check the materials.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
現在...
一切都準備好了！
開始之前，讓我
檢查一下材料。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
^CE0000Shrimp^000000, ^CE0000Chiles^000000, ^CE0000Lemons^000000...
Fish sauce and other little things...

[Mali the Spicy]
Perfect!
Shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
完美！
我們開始吧？

scripts.text:
^FF0031*Chop chop*^000000
^FF9C00*Tup tup tup*^000000
^639CFF*Pu pu^000000 -

[Mali the Spicy]
- ^9C6300Tup tup^000000 ^006363chook^000000
^316363Chop chop^000000
^FF0000Tup tup tup^000000 ^009C00Pu pu^000000 -

[Mali the Spicy]
Wah^00009Cah^0000FFahhhh^0063FFaaaahhh^000000!

[Mali the Spicy]
Here's your
Tom Yum Goong!
Ah~ This taste,
this scent... Yeah.
I know I did a good job.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
這是您的泰式BBQ！
啊~ 這個味道，
這個香氣... 沒錯。
我知道我做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Do you know what is the secret of Tom Yum Goong? It isn't simply just food. This has the power to heal you, and help you get into better shape.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
你知道泰式BBQ的秘密嗎？它不僅僅是食物。它擁有治癒的力量，還能幫助你恢復體力。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Because...
It contains the
power of God.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
因為...
它蘊含著
神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Okay...!
I'm giving you
10 Tom Yum Goong
free of charge~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
好...！
我免費送你
10份泰式BBQ~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Thank you for all the trouble that you have been though to get these ingredients. It would make me happy if you shared Tom Yum Goong with your friends.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
謝謝你辛苦收集這些食材。如果你能和朋友們分享泰式BBQ，我會很高興的。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Share the flavor of Ayothaya, and let them know how beautiful our land is. It was good to see you, take care now~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
分享哎喲泰雅的美味，讓他們知道我們的土地有多美麗。很高興見到你，再見~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Huh? What did you do with the Chiles? You didn't eat them all on the way here, did you?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
咦？辣椒呢？你難道在來的路上把它們都吃光了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Hmm...
You seem to be carrying too many things. Why don't you free up some space in your inventory first, and then come back?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
嗯...
你好像攜帶了太多東西。為什麼不先清理一下背包空間，然後再回來呢？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Ah...!
So busy, so busy!
My customers never get tired of
the taste of my Tom Yum Goong!
Heh heh heh~!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 瑪麗]
啊...！
好忙，好忙！
我的顧客們永遠吃不膩
我的泰式BBQ！
嘿嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你目前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後重試。 -

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Come adventurers,
take a look! I have
plenty of Shrimp!
scripts.translation:
[通普]
冒險者們，
來看看！我有
很多蝦！

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
You're looking for Shrimp,
aren't you? How many Shrimp
do you need? Twenty? Forty?
scripts.translation:
[通普]
你在找蝦，
對吧？你需要多少蝦？
二十隻？四十隻？

scripts.text: I need Shrimp for Tom Yum Goong.
scripts.translation: 我需要蝦來做泰式BBQ。

scripts.text: Err, they look expensive.
scripts.translation: 呃，它們看起來很貴。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Ah! I guess Ms. Mali the Spicy recommended me to you. I guess
that also means you want to buy them in bulk?
scripts.translation:
[通普]
啊！我想是辣妹 瑪麗推薦你來的吧。那也就是說你想批次購買？

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
After all,
you'll need a larger
amount of Shrimp to
cook Tom Yum Goong.
scripts.translation:
[通普]
畢竟，
要做泰式BBQ，
你需要大量的蝦。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Oh yes, you will need 20 Shrimps for Ms. Mali's Tom Yum Goong.
I'll even give you a discount:
11,000 zeny for 20 shrimps.
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[通普]
沒錯，辣妹 瑪麗的泰式BBQ需要20只蝦。
我甚至可以給你打折：
20只蝦只要11,000 Zeny。
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I will take them.
scripts.translation: 我要買。

scripts.text: I could get 100 Jellopies for that much!
scripts.translation: 這點錢能買100個果凍派！

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Good, now you have the
freshest Shrimp in this village! It's time for you to go back and ask Ms. Mali to cook them for you.
scripts.translation:
[通普]
很好，現在你擁有了這個村莊最新鮮的蝦！是時候回去請辣妹 瑪麗為你烹飪了。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Awww...
You're carrying too much stuff with you. I don't think you can carry more than what you have right now.
scripts.translation:
[通普]
哎呀...
你攜帶的東西太多了。我覺得你無法再攜帶比現在更多的東西了。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Awww...
You don't have
enough money.
scripts.translation:
[通普]
哎呀...
你的錢不夠。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Well well well...
You might fill your hungry stomach with that many Jellopies but they wouldn't taste as good as my Shrimp!
scripts.translation:
[通普]
哎呀哎呀...
雖然你可以用那麼多果凍派填飽肚子，但它們可沒有我的蝦好吃！

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
What...?
Do you think
it's expensive?
But the fantastic taste
of Tom Yum Goong
is priceless!
scripts.translation:
[通普]
什麼...？
你覺得貴嗎？
但泰式BBQ那絕妙的味道是無價的！

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Mmm...?
Did you need
more Shrimps?
Would you like
to buy more?
scripts.translation:
[通普]
嗯...？
你需要更多蝦嗎？
要再買一些嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
There you go~
The freshest Shrimp you can ever get in this village, and maybe even the world!
scripts.translation:
[通普]
給你~
這是這個村莊，甚至可能是全世界最新鮮的蝦！

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Awww...
You're carrying too much stuff with you. I don't think you can carry more than what you have right now.
scripts.translation:
[通普]
哎呀...
你攜帶的東西太多了。我覺得你無法再攜帶比現在更多的東西了。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Awww...
You don't have
enough money.
scripts.translation:
[通普]
哎呀...
你的錢不夠。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Good, now you have gotten the freshest shrimps in this village!
It's time for you to go back and ask Ms. Mali to cook for you.
scripts.translation:
[通普]
很好，現在你擁有了這個村莊最新鮮的蝦！
是時候回去請辣妹 瑪麗為你烹飪了。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Welcome, welcome!
I've got the best Shrimp caught in the cleanest waters in the world~!
scripts.translation:
[通普]
歡迎，歡迎！
我有在世界上最清澈的水域捕獲的最棒的蝦~！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你目前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後重試。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Umm...?
You don't need
more Lemons
again, do you?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
嗯...？
你不需要更多檸檬
了吧？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Give me Lemons, old man!
scripts.translation: 給我檸檬，老頭！

scripts.text: Can I have some more Lemons, please?
scripts.translation: 能再給我一些檸檬嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Then why don't you taste
the Lemons I gave you last time? They're really sour, but also very delicious!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
那你為什麼不去嚐嚐我上次給你的檸檬呢？它們真的很酸，但也非常美味！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
What...!?
What's wrong with you, kid?
What have you done with the
Lemons I gave you last time?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
什麼...！？
你怎麼了，小孩？
我上次給你的檸檬你拿去幹什麼了？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Oh, I am sorry....recently my lemon storage
was attacked by ^3131FF'Leaf Cats'^000000 that are roaming around the Shrine.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
哦，對不起....最近我的檸檬倉庫
被在神龕附近遊蕩的^3131FF群葉貓^000000襲擊了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
I wish that I could help you,
but I don't even have enough lemons for my business.
If you need lemons, why don't you go hunt them?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
我很想幫你，
但我連做生意用的檸檬都不夠。
如果你需要檸檬，為什麼不去獵取一些呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
...

- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你目前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後重試。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hello, there?
Did you need
some help...?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
你好，在嗎？
你需要
什麼幫助...？

scripts.text: I need some Lemons.
scripts.translation: 我需要一些檸檬。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Umm...
Lemons?
As you see, I have plenty
of Lemons on my tree.
Do you really need some?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
嗯...
檸檬？
你看，我的樹上有很多檸檬。
你真的需要一些嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I will pay you.
scripts.translation: 是的，我會付錢給你。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
I started growing this Lemon tree as a hobby, but I didn't expect to have such a good harvest of sweet,
succulent Lemons.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
我種這棵檸檬樹只是作為愛好，但我沒想到能收穫這麼多甜美多汁的檸檬。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Did you just say you were
going to pay me for the Lemons?
Oh, you've got me wrong. I don't intend to sell these.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
你剛才說是要付錢買檸檬嗎？
哎呀，你誤會了。我可沒打算賣這些。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
But...
I'm more than willing
to share some of them with
you, but only if you can...
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
不過...
我非常樂意分一些給你，
但前提是你能...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Play a small game with me!
How about that? I've been so bored to death. Even an old man like me needs to enjoy himself!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
陪我玩個小遊戲！
怎麼樣？我都無聊死了。像我這樣的老人也需要盡興一下！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hahahaha~!
What do you say?
Would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
哈哈哈哈哈~！
你覺得如何？
想試試嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, why not!
scripts.translation: 好啊，為什麼不呢！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Good!
The game I want us
to play is an easy
children's game.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
很好！
我想玩的遊戲是個
簡單的兒童遊戲。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
^660000Rock,
Paper, Scissors!^000000
Perhaps you've heard
of it in your land.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
^660000石頭、
剪刀、布！^000000
也許你在你的家鄉
聽說過它。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Nuh-uh, don't look at me like that. I'm an old man, and I want to play this game and re-live my youth
a little bit. You'll understand when you're my age.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
別那樣看著我。我是個老人，我想玩這個遊戲，重溫一下青春。
等你到了我這個年紀就會明白了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Alright, if you win
^3131FF3^000000 out of ^3131FF5^000000 matches,
The Lemons are yours.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
好了，如果你贏
^3131FF3^000000 局中的 ^3131FF5^000000 局，
檸檬就是你的了。
準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Okay...
As you kids say,
^990000Let's get eXtreme!^000000
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
好吧...
就像你們年輕人說的，
^990000讓我們盡情狂歡吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Rock!
Paper!
Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
石頭！
剪刀！
布！

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石頭

scripts.text: Paper
scripts.translation: 布

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hmpf.
It's a draw.
One more time!
Rock! Paper!
Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
哼。
平局。
再來一次！
石頭！剪刀！
布！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Yes...!
Oh my God, yes!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
是的...！
天哪，是的！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
What...?
I don't believe it!
Bah.. !
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
什麼...？
我不相信！
真是的..！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
No...!
Sacrilege!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
不...！
大逆不道！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hmpf.
It's a draw.
One more time!
Rock! Paper!
Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
哼。
平局。
再來一次！
石頭！剪刀！
布！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Bwahahaha!
You lose, kid!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
你輸了，小孩！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Heh heh~
Young fool!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
嘿嘿~
愚蠢的年輕人！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Noooo...!
This cannot be!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
不...！
這不可能！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hmpf.
It's a draw.
One more time!
Rock! Paper!
Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
哼。
平局。
再來一次！
石頭！剪刀！
布！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
You... won.
I'm so exhausted.
I guess I can't compete
with you youngsters
anymore. Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
你...贏了。
我累壞了。
看來我跟你們年輕人
比不了了。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
As promised,
I shall share some
of my Lemons with you.
Grab as many as you want!
^3355FFYou have plucked
10 Lemons from the tree.^000000
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
如我所願，
我會分一些
我的檸檬給你。
想拿多少就拿多少！
^3355FF你從樹上摘了
10個檸檬。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hmm...
Looks like you need a lot of them. Oh well, that's fine with me. I had a good time with you.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
嗯...
看來你需要很多。好吧，這對我來說沒問題。和你在一起我很開心。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Don't forget this though:
Don't be selfish, and always share what you have with others. That's one of the most important values for human beings.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
不過別忘了：
不要自私，要總是與他人分享你擁有的東西。這是人類最重要的價值觀之一。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Muhahahaha!
Victory is mine!
Looks like you won't be getting
any Lemons for now! But feel free to challenge me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
穆哈哈哈！
勝利屬於我！
看來你暫時拿不到檸檬了！但隨時歡迎挑戰我！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Afraid are we?
There's no fooling you:
I'm one of the best at games!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
害怕了嗎？
別想騙我：
我是遊戲高手之一！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hmm...
Now what can
I possibly do
with all these
Lemons?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
嗯...
這麼多檸檬
我到底能拿它們
做什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Feel free to
ask me for help
any time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
隨時歡迎
向我求助，
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
...

[Merchant Thongdum]
Hello, there~
Are you looking for
ingredients to make
Tom Yum Goong?
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
你好呀~
你在找做
泰式BBQ的
食材嗎？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Let's see...
I'm selling chiles,
fish sauce, and some
spices and flavorings
you'll need. I'll sell
it all to you for 2,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
讓我看看...
我在賣辣椒、
魚露，還有一些
你需要的香料和調味料。
全部賣給你，2000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Thanks, I'll take it.
scripts.translation: 謝謝，我買了。

scripts.text: It's a rip-off, man!
scripts.translation: 太貴了，夥計！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Thank you.
I hope you will enjoy
your Tom Yum Goong~
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
謝謝。
希望你享受
你的泰式BBQ~

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Uh oh...
It looks like
you're carrying
too much stuff
right now.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
哎呀...
看起來你
現在攜帶的
東西太多了。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
I can't give you
anything if you don't
have the room to hold it!
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
如果你沒有空間
裝下它們，
我就不能給你任何東西！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Hmm...?
Right now, it looks
like you don't have the
money to buy what you
need from me.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
嗯...？
現在，看起來
你沒有足夠的錢
從我這裡買你需要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Don't say that.
My prices are always
reasonable. I want you to know
that I'm a respectable Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
別這麼說。
我的價格總是
合理的。我希望你知道
我是一個受人尊敬的商人。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
I thought I provided you
with enough ingredients, but
now that I think about it, I don't
know how much Tom Yum Goong
you're making.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
我以為我提供了
足夠的食材，但
現在想想，我不知道
你要做多少泰式BBQ。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Would you like to
buy some more Chilis?
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
你想再買
一些辣椒嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Fare well~
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
再見~

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Thank you,
come again!
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
謝謝，
歡迎再來！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Uh oh...
It looks like
you're carrying
too much stuff
right now.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
哎呀...
看起來你
現在攜帶的
東西太多了。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
I can't give you
anything if you don't
have the room to hold it!
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
如果你沒有空間
裝下它們，
我就不能給你任何東西！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Hmm...?
Right now, it looks
like you don't have the
money to buy what you
need from me.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
嗯...？
現在，看起來
你沒有足夠的錢
從我這裡買你需要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Hello there!
Ever try a Chili before?
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
你好！
你試過辣椒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdom]
Despite its tiny appearance,
it has a very strong flavor. It's also hot and spicy, so you should be careful when you eat one.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
別看它個頭小，味道卻非常濃郁。而且又熱又辣，吃的時候要小心哦。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
The people of Ayothaya enjoy sensational food with distinct, spicy flavors. In Ayothayan cuisine, we use things like Chilis, garlic, ginger and cilantro.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
哎喲泰雅的人們喜歡口味獨特、辛辣刺激的食物。在哎喲泰雅的料理中，我們會使用辣椒、大蒜、姜和香菜等食材。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
I'm selling Chilis,
so if you need any,
please come to me~
scripts.translation:
[商人 通頓]
我在賣辣椒，
如果你需要的話，
請隨時來找我~
